tasks.name: BackgroundTaskCoreConsole
tasks.purpose: Start the local console at sign-in without opening a browser; reuse an existing compatible server.

tasks.name: BackgroundTaskCoreHealth
tasks.purpose: Hourly health pass: publishes the passive observation snapshot, judges every watched task, ingests health into the console database, and pushes the digest and its own heartbeat.

health.label: the monitor itself (hourly)
health.artifact_note: The console reads this synchronous task's Scheduler result. Each run also advances the existing schedule-reminder dead-man item task-health:monitor-watchdog.

tasks.name: RefreshConsoleRunlog
tasks.purpose: Daily full console ingest: the run-event half that the hourly health pass skips. The Windows Operational log is a circular buffer of about five days, so a missed window is permanent.

health.label: background-task-core run-event ingest (daily 04:20)
health.artifact_written_only_on_success: The ingester writes this stamp on the run-log path only, after the commit, so a rolled-back ingest leaves no stamp. The database and the monthly export are written on failed runs too, so neither can prove success.

tasks.name: BackgroundTaskCoreXmlExport
tasks.purpose: Daily reference export of the Scheduler XML of every task in the authority's TaskNames projection into the companion's data/task-exports.
